claims.text: TLS: hydration and allopurinol or rasburicase.
claims.quote: Hydration and allopurinol or rasburicase are used for treatment of hyperuricemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia, and hyperkalemia

claims.text: Rasburicase: often given to prevent TLS but may cause hemolytic anemia in G6PD deficiency.
claims.quote: rasburicase, which is often given to prevent tumor lysis syndrome but may cause hemolytic anemia in patients with G6PD deficiency
